title: Published LUNA16 & Nodule CAD Benchmarks Comparison
evaluation_context: Track 2 False-Positive Reduction vs. Complete End-to-End CAD Systems

internal_benchmark.task: False-Positive Reduction on supplied candidates_V2 (79,135 candidates)
internal_benchmark.training_regime: 100% from scratch on LUNA16 Folds 1-9 (zero pretrained weights)

external_evaluation.cohort: SPIE-AAPM LUNGx Challenge (58 unexposed scans, 70 nodules)
external_evaluation.matching_protocol: Fixed 5.0 mm Euclidean distance (non-official, single center coordinate)
external_evaluation.critical_finding: Classifier achieves 100% sensitivity on covered nodules under Rule B at 0.5 cut; external sensitivity bottleneck is strictly proposal candidate coverage (67.14%), not classifier discrimination.

published_literature_reference_points.study: Setio et al. (2017) IEEE TMI (LUNA16 Grand Challenge)
published_literature_reference_points.task: Track 2: False Positive Reduction on candidates_V2
published_literature_reference_points.matching_protocol: Official LUNA16 diameter-based matching (distance < nodule radius)
published_literature_reference_points.notes: Top ensemble of multiple CAD and deep learning systems combined. Individual CAD algorithms scored CPM 0.772 to 0.839.

published_literature_reference_points.study: Dou et al. (2017) Medical Image Analysis
published_literature_reference_points.notes: Multi-level contextual 3D CNN without multi-model ensemble averaging.
Candidate generation using Faster R-CNN followed by 3D DCNN FP reduction.
Multi-branch architecture combining 2D slices and 3D volumes.

essential_scientific_caveats.description: CLEAR3D-MSFv2 internal test (CPM = 0.9043) is evaluated on Subset 0 (Fold 0, 89 scans), whereas literature benchmarks report 10-fold cross-validation averages across all 888 scans. Fold 0 was historically exposed in earlier runs, so this result cannot be claimed as an unseen blind competition victory.

External validation on SPIE-AAPM uses fixed 5.0 mm Euclidean matching because LUNGx provides only single (x, y, z) biopsy coordinates without 3D segmentation or diameter annotations, unlike LUNA16 radius-based matching.

essential_scientific_caveats.caveat: Ground Truth Incompleteness in External Cohort
essential_scientific_caveats.description: SPIE-AAPM LUNGx only annotates biopsy-confirmed diagnostic target nodules (1-2 per scan). Non-annotated incidental benign or malignant nodules are counted as false positives, biasing the apparent FP/scan upward.

The prior comparison claiming an architectural CPM improvement from 0.0424 (MedicalNet) to 0.9043 is formally retracted as uncontrolled (differed across 6 distinct factors: model architecture, weights, candidate pool size 2,952 vs 472,507, input channels, 1x1 vs 5x4 TTA, and calibration).
